The '''2018–19 TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team''' represented [[Texas Christian University]] in the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]], led by head coach [[Jamie Dixon]] in his third season at TCU. The Horned Frogs competed as members of the [[Big 12 Conference]] and played their home games at [[Schollmaier Arena]] in [[Fort Worth, Texas]].  They finished the season 23–14, 7–11 to tie for 7th place.  As the No. 8 seed in the Big 12 Tournament, they defeated [[2018–19 Oklahoma State Cowboys basketball team|Oklahoma State]] in the first round before losing to [[2018–19 Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball team|Kansas State]] in the quarterfinals. They received an at-large bid to the NIT, where they defeated [[2018–19 Sam Houston State Bearkats men's basketball team|Sam Houston State]], [[2018–19 Nebraska Cornhuskers men's basketball team|Nebraska]] and [[2018–19 Creighton Bluejays men's basketball team|Creighton]] to advance to the semifinals, where they lost to in conference member [[2018–19 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team|Texas]].

==Previous season==
The Horned Frogs finished the season 21–12, 9–9 in [[2017–18 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 play]] to finish in fifth place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2018 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]] to [[2017–18 Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball team|Kansas State]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] for the first time since 1998 as the No. 6 seed in the Midwest region, where they lost in the first round to [[2017–18 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]].
